newsitem.title: UK: Northern Ireland police foil mine attack.
newsitem.headline: Northern Ireland police foil mine attack.

text.p: Northern Ireland police said on Monday they had foiled an attempted guerrilla attack using a landmine near Londonderry, the province's second city.
"It appears the terrorists were planning to carry out a landmine attack on a security force patrol," a police spokesman said.
Police were alerted after people were seen acting suspiciously in an area of the city close to the border with County Donegal in the Irish Republic.
They found a hole dug into a bank and a concealed detonating wire in apparent preparation for a strike against security forces. No arrests were made.
British troops and Northern Ireland police have been the target of Irish Republican Army guerrillas fighting to end British rule and unite the province with the Irish Republic.
